title: Mineralogical Comparison between Crocidolite and Amosite Asbestos using Atomic Resolution Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy
content: Asbestos is a fibrous material that has been predominantly utilized as a fire protection material in buildings due to its exceptional heat resistance. However, its extremely fine morphology, known as asbestiform, allows it to be easily inhaled into the human lungs, potentially causing negative impacts on the human body, such as cancer and mesothelioma.
